description: Designate a specific current or historical version as the only official version. Replaces the previous designation; latest and immutable contents do not change. Use expected_revision from get_site to reject stale changes.

share_token.description: Token from a user-provided share URL; carries only that share permission.

slug.description: Artifact identifier returned by find/publish, or the slug in its /s/ URL. Not a local path.

tenant_id.description: Destination tenant for creation; defaults to the account tenant.

name: artifact_site_set_official
title: Set official version
